F1: The migration indexes the first query result before checking whether a matching category exists, so an empty result raises.
F2: Migrated host values bypass model normalization, so URL-form entries will not match runtime host lookups.
F3: Interpolating legacy host values into SQL allows quotes to break the migration or alter its SQL.
F4: The validation regex rejects valid domains with top-level domains longer than five letters.
F5: The specs lack endpoint coverage, but missing tests alone do not establish a defect in behavior.
